title: SAIL × Baseline Energy Hackathon 2024
summary: A first-place hackathon solution that forecasts electricity consumption with a hybrid CNN-LSTM → XGBoost model.

case.problem: Forecast short-term electricity consumption from real energy data for the UiS × Baseline Energy challenge — under hackathon time pressure, in a two-person team.
case.data: Provided electricity-consumption time-series dataset from the challenge.
case.approach: A hybrid pipeline: a CNN-LSTM feature extractor to capture temporal and spatial structure in the load signal, feeding XGBoost to sharpen the final regression. Delivered end-to-end — data prep → model → evaluation — with reproducible code and the dataset.
results: Won 1st place at the UiS SAIL × Baseline Energy Hackathon 2024 (two-person team, "3M").
Combined deep temporal feature extraction with gradient boosting for the final forecast.

title: Medical Emergency Agent
summary: An LLM agent that answers medical-emergency queries via retrieval over a property-graph knowledge store and call transcripts.

case.problem: Answer medical-emergency questions reliably, grounding the LLM in real call-transcript data rather than letting it hallucinate.
case.data: A call-transcript corpus plus a property-graph knowledge store and a vector store for retrieval.
case.approach: Retrieval-augmented generation over the knowledge graph and vector store, orchestrated as an LLM agent, with an interactive Gradio UI. Packaged as a reproducible Poetry project with a src/ layout.
results: A working agent that queries a knowledge graph + vector store and answers through a Gradio interface.
Uses the modern GenAI stack — knowledge graphs, RAG, and agent orchestration — not just prompting.
next: Document the use case, data provenance and privacy note, and add an architecture diagram.
Add a screenshot / GIF of the UI answering a query and a retrieval-accuracy metric.

title: Atari Breakout with DQN
summary: A Deep Q-Network agent that learns to play Atari Breakout from pixels, built as a clean, modular, reproducible codebase.

case.problem: Train an agent to play Atari Breakout from raw pixel input using value-based reinforcement learning.
case.data: The Atari Breakout environment (pixel frames as state).
case.approach: A Deep Q-Network implemented from the ground up, structured as software rather than a single notebook — config-driven training, saved model checkpoints, and a standalone evaluation/inference script.
results: A trained DQN agent on Breakout with a modular, reproducible codebase (config, models, utils).
Separate training and evaluation entry points with pinned dependencies.
next: Fix the README (problem → approach → how to train/run).
Add a learning-curve plot and a GIF of the trained agent playing.

title: ECIU AI Hackathon — LangGraph agent
summary: An agentic LLM workflow modelling an interview + document-retrieval process as an explicit LangGraph StateGraph.

case.problem: Model an interview-and-document-retrieval process as a controllable, inspectable LLM workflow.
case.data: Interview prompts and a document corpus for retrieval.
case.approach: A LangGraph StateGraph with explicit nodes (greet, answer, retrieve) and conditional edges, using LangChain and Pydantic for structured node logic, with the compiled graph visualized.
results: A compiled state-graph agent demonstrating controllable orchestration, not just prompting.
Structured, typed node logic with LangChain + Pydantic.

title: IPL Analysis — R Shiny dashboard
summary: An interactive R Shiny dashboard exploring Indian Premier League cricket data (2008–2019).

case.problem: Make IPL cricket data explorable through an interactive dashboard (a Sparks Foundation internship task).
case.data: IPL matches and ball-by-ball delivery data, 2008–2019.
case.approach: An R Shiny app with interactive filtering and exploratory visualizations over the matches and deliveries datasets.
results: An interactive dashboard covering IPL matches and ball-by-ball data across 2008–2019.
Evidence of R + Shiny + dashboarding breadth.
